name: WatercolourWashField
job: Paint a slow watercolour wash behind content that blooms in from the edges as the block enters view, pigment pooling at the borders
owner_settings: Small heading, headline, paragraph, button label and link
mobile: smaller canvas (lower render resolution, smaller wash reach), static after bloom
motion: wash spreads with a warped-noise shader for ~3.4s, rims darken as it 'dries', then stops completely; text staggers in (reduced-motion: finished painted wash, text shown at once)

checks.render: pass (fix used: grid column minmax(0,1fr) + content width; the 375 shot's right-edge crop is the headless minimum-window artifact, also seen on CardStack; verified no overflow at a real 375 viewport)
checks.craft: 3 after polish pass (noise scale and wash reach tied to block size, finer mobile render scale)

art_direction: Paper wash: cold-press paper grain, dusty rose and sea-glass blooms, darker pigment rims, always low contrast behind text
